about.free: About window paragraph under the buttons. Product name Backseat stays untranslated.
about.license: About window footer; {license} = license name, e.g. MIT.
about.licenseFull: About window footer link that opens the LICENSE file.
about.reportProblem: About window button (opens the GitHub issues page), one of three in a row. Keep short.
about.support: About window button (donate / sponsor the project), one of three in a row. Keep short; keep the ☕ emoji.
about.thirdParty: About window footer link that opens THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
about.viewOnGithub: About window button, one of three in a row in a 420 px wide window. Keep short.
agents.claudeApp: Send-target label (editor target menu, status bar): the Claude desktop app. Keep the product name.
agents.codexApp: Send-target label: the Codex / ChatGPT desktop app. Keep the product names and the dot.
agents.fallbackSuffix: Appended after a target label (with a space; the code adds it) when the last real window is reused because the hotkey was pressed from the desktop or tray.
agents.instruction.mcp: One-line instruction pasted into the agent's terminal/chat when the agent is connected through MCP (an AI agent reads it). Keep backseat_latest. {brief} = absolute path of brief.md.
agents.instruction.paths: One-line instruction pasted into the agent's terminal/chat (an AI agent reads it, imperative). {brief} and {image} = absolute file paths.
agents.terminal: Send-target label: a terminal window without a recognised agent. {process} = executable name, e.g. WindowsTerminal.exe.
agents.terminalAgent: Send-target label: an agent running in a terminal window. {agent} = agent name such as Claude Code (not translated).
agents.webChat: Send-target label: a browser window showing an AI chat. {title} = page title cut to 30 characters.
agents.window: Send-target label for any other window. {title} = window title cut to 30 characters, {process} = executable name.
app.tagline: About window tagline under the app name
brief.activeWindow: brief.md line. The window that had focus before the capture hotkey. {title} = window title, {process} = executable name. Read by an AI agent.
brief.annotation.arrow: brief.md annotation line label (arrow). One short word.
brief.annotation.blur: brief.md annotation line label (blur that hides content).
brief.annotation.number: brief.md annotation line label (numbered badge). {n} = the badge number the user placed.
brief.annotation.pen: brief.md annotation line label (freehand stroke). One short word.
brief.annotation.rect: brief.md annotation line label (rectangle). One short word.
brief.annotation.text: brief.md annotation line label (text annotation). One short word; followed by an optional style note and the quoted text.
brief.annotations.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above the numbered list of annotations.
brief.capture: brief.md capture description line, read by an AI agent. {mode} = brief.mode.*; {what} = optional ' "window title" (process.exe)' (starts with a space, may be empty); {display} = display id; {x},{y},{w},{h} = region in DIP; {pw},{ph} = size in px; {scale} = display scale factor; {scroll} = optional ' · …' text from brief.scroll (may be empty). Keep DIP and px.
brief.compare: brief.md line, present when the user compared with the previous capture. {id} = previous session folder name, {mode} = brief.compare.overlay/wipe/diff, {percent} = percentage of changed pixels. Keep annotated.png.
brief.compare.diff: Before/after comparison mode name inside brief.compare ({mode}). Same word as the editor's compare mode.
brief.compare.overlay: Before/after comparison mode name inside brief.compare ({mode}). Same word as the editor's compare mode.
brief.compare.wipe: Before/after comparison mode name inside brief.compare ({mode}). Same word as the editor's compare mode.
brief.crop: brief.md line, present only when the user cropped. {x},{y} = top-left of the kept area, {w}×{h} = its size, in px of the uncropped capture. Read by an AI agent.
brief.globals.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above speech lines that belong to no annotation.
brief.interp.blur: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), only when the capture has a blur annotation.
brief.interp.coords: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), read by an AI agent. Keep annotated.png and the arrow.
brief.interp.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') for the reading guide at the end.
brief.interp.speech: brief.md reading-guide bullet (the code adds '- '), only when there is speech. The quoted words must be the pointing words (this/here) of the language the sentence is written in. Keep 🗣.
brief.memo.heading: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') above the user's one-line note about the whole image.
brief.mode.full: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'full screen'.
brief.mode.region: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'region'.
brief.mode.scroll: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'scrolling capture'.
brief.mode.window: brief.md capture line, {mode} of brief.capture: capture mode 'window'.
brief.notice: brief.md line 2 (blockquote, read by an AI agent). Warns that the drawn marks are user annotations, not part of the screen. Keep the quoted letter B.
brief.notice.original: brief.md, appended after brief.notice when the package has an un-annotated screenshot; {file} = file name such as screenshot.png. Read by an AI agent.
brief.original: brief.md line under the image. {file} = file name of the capture without annotations (screenshot.png).
brief.request.agentFallback: Used as {agent} in brief.request.title when the agent did not give its name. Lowercase noun is fine.
brief.request.title: brief.md section heading (the code adds '## ') when the capture answers a backseat_ask question. {agent} = the asking agent's name or brief.request.agentFallback.
brief.scroll.one: brief.md, tail of the capture line for scrolling captures (code puts ' · ' before it). {n} = number of stitched frames, {viewport} = height of one frame in px. Plural form.
brief.scroll.other: brief.md, tail of the capture line for scrolling captures (code puts ' · ' before it). {n} = number of stitched frames, {viewport} = height of one frame in px. Plural form.
brief.speech.auto: brief.md, in parentheses at the end of a speech line (🗣): automatically aligned with this confidence. {confidence} = number 0.00-1.00.
brief.speech.manual: brief.md, in parentheses at the end of a speech line (🗣): the user linked this sentence to the annotation by hand.
brief.target: brief.md line. {label} = display name of the window/agent the package is sent to (already in the UI language).
brief.textStyle.bold: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·' (e.g. '(bold·italic)'). One lowercase word.
brief.textStyle.italic: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'. One lowercase word.
brief.textStyle.normal: brief.md style note for a text annotation that is explicitly not bold, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'.
brief.textStyle.shadow: brief.md style note for a text annotation, shown in parentheses and joined with '·'. One lowercase word.
brief.voice: brief.md line when speech was recorded. {seconds} = duration with one decimal (e.g. 12.3), {model} = speech model name. Keep transcript.json.
colorpicker.custom: Tooltip and accessible name of the small '+' swatch that opens the system color chooser.
colorpicker.dialog: Accessible name (aria-label) of the color picker popover; not visible.
colorpicker.eyedropper: Button label next to an eyedropper icon (pick a color from the screen). Short: the button is about 100 px wide.
colorpicker.eyedropperAria: Accessible name (aria-label) of the eyedropper button; not visible.
colorpicker.hexCode: Accessible name (aria-label) of the text field where a color like #RRGGBB is typed; not visible.
colorpicker.noRecent: Shown in the recent-colors row when no color has been used yet.
colorpicker.recent: Small label in front of the row of recently used colors. One short word.
dialog.saveCapture: Title bar of the save-as dialog for the annotated PNG.
dialog.saveVideo: Title bar of the save-as dialog for the WebM/MP4 replay of the drawing session.
editor.color.title: Title of the colour popover opened from the main colour button.
editor.compare.after: Small label drawn on the image right of the wipe line (current capture). Very short (about 6 characters): drawn in a small box on the canvas.
editor.compare.available: Status bar text when the editor opens and a previous capture of the same region exists. O is a shortcut key, keep it.
editor.compare.before: Small label drawn on the image left of the wipe line (previous capture). Very short (about 6 characters): drawn in a small box on the canvas.
editor.compare.diff: Comparison mode button and mode name (shows only what changed). Short.
editor.compare.diffLabel: Right side of the compare bar. {percent} = share of pixels that differ, a number like 3.2.
editor.compare.diffTip: Tooltip of the Difference comparison mode button.
editor.compare.label: Accessible name of the before/after comparison bar.
editor.compare.modes: Accessible name of the group of comparison mode buttons.
editor.compare.none: Status bar text when O is pressed but there is no previous capture. {item} = the tray menu item name (Recapture last region).
editor.compare.off: Status bar text after turning the comparison off.
editor.compare.opacity: Label of the slider that sets the overlay opacity in the compare bar. Short.
editor.compare.overlay: Comparison mode button and mode name (previous capture laid over the current one, semi-transparent). Short.
editor.compare.overlayTip: Tooltip of the Overlay comparison mode button.
editor.compare.position: Label of the slider that moves the wipe line in the compare bar. Short.
editor.compare.status: Status bar text while comparison is on. {mode} = the mode name (Overlay / Wipe / Difference). O is a shortcut key, keep it.
editor.compare.toggle: Button in the compare bar that turns the before/after comparison on or off. Short.
editor.compare.wipe: Comparison mode button and mode name (a vertical line splits previous and current). Short.
editor.compare.wipeTip: Tooltip of the Wipe comparison mode button.
editor.debug.addAnnotations: Debug/self-test only: name of an undo step. Not shown to normal users.
editor.debug.transcriptInjected: Debug/self-test only: status bar text. {count} = number of transcript segments.
editor.font.blackHanSans: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Black Han Sans.
editor.font.doHyeon: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Do Hyeon.
editor.font.jua: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Jua.
editor.font.nanumGothic: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean font Nanum Gothic. Transliterate or keep the Latin name.
editor.font.nanumPen: Font drop-down entry: display name of the Korean handwriting font Nanum Pen Script.
editor.font.system: Font drop-down entry: the system UI font.
editor.history.arrow: Name of an undo step: an arrow was drawn.
editor.history.badge: Name of an undo step: a numbered badge was placed.
editor.history.blur: Name of an undo step: a blur region was added.
editor.history.crop: Name of an undo step: the image was cropped.
editor.history.erase: Name of an undo step: annotations were erased with the eraser.
editor.history.linkAdd: Name of an undo step: a speech line was linked to an annotation in the timeline (glossary: link).
editor.history.linkRemove: Name of an undo step: a speech line was unlinked from an annotation.
editor.history.pen: Name of an undo step: a pen stroke was drawn. Appears inside the undo/redo tooltip.
editor.history.rect: Name of an undo step: a rectangle was drawn.
editor.history.redoTip: Tooltip of the redo button when there is something to redo. {label} = the step's name. Keep Ctrl+Shift+Z.
editor.history.text: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was added.
editor.history.textEdit: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was edited.
editor.history.textMove: Name of an undo step: a text annotation was moved.
editor.history.undoTip: Tooltip of the undo button when there is something to undo. {label} = the step's name (editor.history.* e.g. Pen, Crop). Keep Ctrl+Z.
editor.hotkey.badge: Command name (select the numbered badge tool).
editor.hotkey.close: Command name (close the editor), shortcut Esc.
editor.hotkey.compare: Command name / tooltip of the compare toggle button, followed by the shortcut O.
editor.hotkey.copy: Command name in a tooltip, followed by the shortcut.
editor.hotkey.home: Command name (timeline: jump to the start), shortcut Home.
editor.hotkey.live: Command name (timeline: jump back to the live editing state), shortcut End.
editor.hotkey.mic: Command name / tooltip of the microphone record button, followed by the shortcut M.
editor.hotkey.pin: Command name / tooltip of the pin button (keep the editor on top as a small reference window), followed by the shortcut Ctrl+P.
editor.hotkey.redo: Command name in the redo button tooltip, followed by the shortcut; also the redo button's accessible name.
editor.hotkey.save: Command name in a tooltip, followed by the shortcut.
editor.hotkey.send: Command name, shown in the tooltip with its shortcut: 'Send (Enter)'.
editor.hotkey.stepBack: Command name (timeline: step back 0.2 seconds), shortcut Left arrow.
editor.hotkey.stepFwd: Command name (timeline: step forward 0.2 seconds), shortcut Right arrow.
editor.hotkey.target: Command name / tooltip of the target bar button, followed by the shortcut Ctrl+T.
editor.hotkey.timeline: Command name / tooltip of the timeline button, followed by the shortcut L.
editor.hotkey.undo: Command name in the undo button tooltip, followed by the shortcut; also the undo button's accessible name.
editor.hotkey.video: Command name / tooltip of the timeline video button (export the drawing session as a WebM video), followed by the shortcut.
editor.memo.placeholder: Placeholder of the note field at the bottom of the editor.
editor.mic.downloading: Status bar text while the speech model downloads. {file} = file name (may be empty), {percent} = integer 0-100.
editor.mic.loadingModel: Status bar text while the speech recognition model loads.
editor.mic.noSound: Status bar error when the recording is empty.
editor.mic.processing: Status bar text while the recording is decoded before transcription.
editor.mic.readFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.recordError: Status bar error from the recorder.
editor.mic.start: Toolbar button that starts voice recording. Keep the 🎤 emoji. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.mic.startFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.stop: Toolbar button text while recording. Keep ■. {time} = elapsed time mm:ss. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.mic.stopFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.transcribeError: Status bar error when the speech engine reported an error without a message.
editor.mic.transcribeFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.mic.transcribed.one: Status bar text after transcription (singular). {n} = number of words.
editor.mic.transcribed.other: Status bar text after transcription (plural). {n} = number of words.
editor.mic.transcribing: Status bar text while speech is transcribed.
editor.mic.unavailable: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.colorPicked: Status bar text after picking a colour. {color} = hex code like #E5484D.
editor.status.copied: Status bar text after copying the image.
editor.status.copyFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.cropped: Status bar text after cropping. {w} and {h} = new size in pixels. Keep px and Ctrl+Z.
editor.status.croppedDropped.one: Status bar text after cropping when annotations outside the crop were removed (singular). {w}, {h} = new size in px, {n} = number removed.
editor.status.croppedDropped.other: Status bar text after cropping when annotations outside the crop were removed (plural). {w}, {h} = new size in px, {n} = number removed.
editor.status.erased.one: Status bar text after erasing (singular). {n} = number of annotations erased.
editor.status.erased.other: Status bar text after erasing (plural). {n} = number of annotations erased.
editor.status.imageFailed: Status bar error when the captured image cannot be shown.
editor.status.pickCanceled: Status bar text when the eyedropper was canceled.
editor.status.pickColor: Status bar text while the eyedropper is active. Keep Esc.
editor.status.pinFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.pinned: Status bar text after pinning the editor. Keep Ctrl+P.
editor.status.saveCanceled: Status bar text when the user closed the save dialog.
editor.status.saveFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.saved: Status bar text after saving. {path} = file path.
editor.status.sendFailed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.status.sending: Status bar text while sending to the target.
editor.status.unknownError: Used as {error} in save/copy/video/transcription errors when no message was given.
editor.status.unpinned: Status bar text after unpinning the editor.
editor.target.agentFallback: Name shown when an agent asking the user a question did not give its own name.
editor.target.ask: Text appended to the target bar when an agent asked the user to show something (backseat_ask). Keep the leading space and the · and ❓. {agent} = agent name, {question} = the agent's question.
editor.target.chipAuto: Chip of the first target menu row for the automatically detected target. Very short.
editor.target.chipPinned: Chip of the first target menu row when the default target is pinned. Very short.
editor.target.clipboardNote: Target bar message after a send that only reached the clipboard. Keep Ctrl+V.
editor.target.hintClipboard: Small hint (target bar and menu rows): the package is only copied to the clipboard.
editor.target.hintPaste: Small hint at the right of the target bar: the package will be pasted into the target window.
editor.target.hintPasteImage: Hint at the right of a target menu row: the image will be pasted.
editor.target.hintPastePath: Hint at the right of a target menu row: the session folder path will be pasted.
editor.target.kindChat: Chip in the target menu: a chat in a web browser.
editor.target.kindClaudeDesktop: Chip in the target menu: the Claude desktop app. Claude is a product name.
editor.target.kindTerminal: Chip in the target menu: a terminal window.
editor.target.kindUnknown: Chip in the target menu: any other window. Very short.
editor.target.label: Target bar label for the detected target window. {label} = window/agent name, e.g. Claude Code.
editor.target.labelChosen: Target bar label when the user picked this window from the menu for this send only. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.target.labelPinned: Target bar label when this window is the pinned default target. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.target.menuLabel: Accessible name of the send-target drop-down list (the window that receives the package).
editor.target.none: Target bar label when no agent window was detected. Keep the · separator.
editor.target.pinDefault: Checkbox at the bottom of the target menu.
editor.target.rowAuto: First target menu row text for the automatically detected target. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.target.rowAutoNone: First target menu row text when nothing was detected.
editor.target.rowPinned: First target menu row text for the pinned default target. {label} = window/agent name.
editor.text.auto: Toggle button: choose the background box colour automatically. Very short.
editor.text.autoTip: Tooltip of the Auto toggle for the background box colour.
editor.text.background: Label of the background-box colour group in the text bar; also the group's accessible name.
editor.text.bgOpacity: Tooltip and accessible name of the background box opacity slider.
editor.text.effect: Label of the text-effect button group in the text bar (box / outline / none); also the group's accessible name. Short: the text bar is one row.
editor.text.effectTip: Tooltip of the text-effect button group.
editor.text.invert: Text-bar button that swaps the text colour and the background colour. Keep the ⇄ symbol. Short.
editor.text.outline: Text-effect button (dark outline around the text), and the label of the outline colour group in the text bar. Short.
editor.text.outlineColor: Tooltip / accessible name of the outline colour button, and title of its colour popover.
editor.text.outlineTip: Tooltip of the outline text-effect button. PowerPoint and Photoshop are product names.
editor.text.plain: Text-effect button: no effect, text only. Short: the text bar is one row.
editor.text.plainTip: Tooltip of the no-effect text button.
editor.text.plate: Text-effect button: text on a translucent background box (glossary: background box). Short: the text bar is one row, ~20 characters per button at most.
editor.text.plateColor: Tooltip / accessible name of the background-box colour button, and title of its colour popover.
editor.text.plateColorAuto: Tooltip of the background-box colour button while the colour is set to Auto.
editor.text.plateTip: Tooltip of the background-box text-effect button. Snagit, Canva and Instagram Stories are product names.
editor.text.sampleGlyph: Sample glyph drawn inside each text-effect button icon (about 18 px square). One or two characters of the language's script.
editor.text.shadow: Toggle button in the text bar (drop shadow), and its tooltip. Short.
editor.timeline.hint: Hint line in the timeline bar. Keep the arrows and the key name Home. About 40 characters at most.
editor.timeline.liveTip: Tooltip of the LIVE button of the timeline (jump back to the present). Keep the key name End.
editor.timeline.playTip: Tooltip of the timeline play button. Keep the key name Space.
editor.timeline.video: Timeline bar button: export the drawing session as a WebM video (glossary: video, not record). Very short.
editor.tl.hint: Hint line in the timeline bar. Keep the arrows and the key name Home. About 40 characters at most.
editor.tl.liveTip: Tooltip of the LIVE button of the timeline (jump back to the present). Keep the key name End.
editor.tl.playTip: Tooltip of the timeline play button. Keep the key name Space.
editor.tl.video: Timeline bar button: export the drawing session as a WebM video (glossary: video, not record). Very short.
editor.tool.arrow: Toolbar button (tool), shortened form. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.arrowTip: Tooltip of the arrow tool button.
editor.tool.badge: Toolbar button (tool) that places numbered badges, and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.blur: Toolbar button (tool) that pixelates a region, and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.crop: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.eraser: Toolbar button (tool). Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.eraserTip: Tooltip of the eraser tool button; E is the shortcut key, keep it.
editor.tool.pen: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.rect: Toolbar button (tool), shortened form of Rectangle. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.tool.rectTip: Tooltip of the rectangle tool button.
editor.tool.text: Toolbar button (tool) and its tooltip. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.boldTip: Tooltip of the bold toggle button (its visible label is the letter B).
editor.toolbar.colorGroup: Accessible name (aria-label) of the colour button group in the editor toolbar. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.colorTip: Tooltip and accessible name of the main colour button.
editor.toolbar.copy: Toolbar button: copy the annotated image to the clipboard. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.fontSizeTip: Tooltip of the font size drop-down.
editor.toolbar.historyGroup: Accessible name (aria-label) of the undo/redo button group. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.italicTip: Tooltip of the italic toggle button (its visible label is the letter I).
editor.toolbar.pin: Accessible name (aria-label) of the pin button (shows a pin emoji); the visible tooltip is editor.hotkey.pin. Not visible text.
editor.toolbar.save: Toolbar button: save the annotated image to a file. Very short: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.send: Primary toolbar button: send the session package to the target agent window. One short verb: toolbar is 820 px wide.
editor.toolbar.text: Label and accessible group name for the text font controls (font, size, bold, italic) in the second toolbar row. Very short.
editor.toolbar.timeline: Toolbar button that shows/hides the timeline panel; also the accessible name of the timeline panel. Short: toolbar is 820 px wide and must not wrap.
editor.toolbar.tools: Accessible name (aria-label) of the group of drawing tool buttons in the editor toolbar. Not visible.
editor.toolbar.width: Label of the stroke-width slider in the second toolbar row; also its group's accessible name. Very short.
editor.toolbar.widthTip: Tooltip of the stroke-width slider. [ and ] are the shortcut keys; keep them.
editor.video.canceled: Status bar text when the user closed the video save dialog.
editor.video.exporting: Status bar text while the drawing session is replayed into a WebM video. {seconds} = duration with one decimal.
editor.video.failed: Status bar error. {error} = technical error message.
editor.video.noAnnotations: Status bar text when exporting a video without any annotation.
editor.video.saved: Status bar text after saving the video. {path} = file path.
mcp.annotationNotice: MCP tool result text shown to an AI agent just before annotated.png.
mcp.askTimeout: MCP tool result for backseat_ask when the timeout passed. {seconds} = timeout in seconds, {requestId} = request id (digits and dash).
mcp.files: MCP tool result header line (AI agent). {files} = comma-separated file names of the session package.
mcp.folder: MCP tool result header line (AI agent). {dir} = absolute session folder path.
mcp.listEmpty: MCP tool result for backseat_list when the list is empty.
mcp.noSession: MCP tool result for backseat_latest when nothing was sent yet. {root} = sessions folder. Keep the key combination Ctrl+Shift+A.
mcp.notFound: MCP tool error result for backseat_get. {id} = the requested session id.
mcp.originalScreen: MCP tool result text placed just before screenshot.png.
mcp.waitTimeout: MCP tool result for backseat_wait when the timeout passed.
palette.calm: Color picker palette tab (muted colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.mono: Color picker palette tab (grayscale). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.pastel: Color picker palette tab (light pastel colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
palette.vivid: Color picker palette tab (saturated colors). One short word: four tabs share one row.
requests.agentFallback: Used as {agent} in requests.title when the agent has no name. Capitalised noun.
requests.body: Desktop notification body. {question} = the agent's question (first line), second line explains the click action.
requests.title: Desktop notification title when an agent asks the user to show something (backseat_ask). {agent} = agent name or requests.agentFallback.
scroll.badge.progress.one: Same badge while capturing. {n} = frames grabbed so far, {height} = stitched height in px. Keep short (about 220 px wide); keep Esc. Plural form.
scroll.badge.progress.other: Same badge while capturing. {n} = frames grabbed so far, {height} = stitched height in px. Keep short (about 220 px wide); keep Esc. Plural form.
scroll.badge.start: Small always-on-top badge shown during scrolling capture (about 220 px wide). Keep short; keep the key name Esc.
selector.hint.full: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, full screen mode. Enter and Esc are key names; keep them.
selector.hint.rect: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, region mode. Enter and Esc are key names; keep them.
selector.hint.scroll: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, scrolling capture mode. Esc is a key name; keep it.
selector.hint.window: Hint at the top of the capture selector overlay, window mode. Esc is a key name; keep it.
selector.mode.full: Capture mode button (full screen), followed by the shortcut letter F (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.mode.rect: Capture mode button in the selector bar, followed by the shortcut letter R (not part of this text). Region capture. Very short.
selector.mode.scroll: Capture mode button (scrolling capture), followed by the shortcut letter S (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.mode.window: Capture mode button, followed by the shortcut letter W (not part of this text). Very short.
selector.scrollLabel: Label next to the highlighted window in scrolling-capture mode. {label} = window title and size, e.g. 'Notepad · 800 × 600 px'.
send.clipboard.noTarget: Editor status message after sending when there is no target window. Keep Ctrl+V.
send.clipboard.target: Editor status message after sending when the target cannot be pasted into automatically. {target} = target label. Keep Ctrl+V.
send.clipboard.targetMcp: Editor status message like send.clipboard.target, for a target that is an MCP-connected agent. Keep backseat_latest/backseat_wait and Ctrl+V.
send.failed: Editor status message when sending threw an error. {error} = the error's message.
send.focusFailed: Editor status message when the target window could not be focused. {target} = target label. Keep Ctrl+V.
send.imageNotice: Prefix of the text pasted together with the image into chat apps; tells the agent that the drawn marks in the image are the user's annotations. Read by an AI agent. Keep the square brackets.
send.pasted: Editor status message after pasting and pressing Enter automatically. {target} = target label.
send.pastedPressEnter: Editor status message after pasting when Enter was not pressed automatically. {target} = target label. Keep the key name Enter.
stt.cloudTranscribing: Editor status bar; {api} = API base URL
stt.noCloudKey: Error in the editor status bar; ': BACKSEAT_STT_API_KEY' is appended
timeline.clock.live: Timeline clock while not scrubbing. {now} = current editor time (e.g. 0:12.3), {total} = end time of the last annotation. LIVE is a fixed label (keep it).
timeline.hint.linkDrag: Hint line at the right of the timeline toolbar while the user drags a speech line (to link it to an annotation). Esc is a key name; keep it.
timeline.lane.pen: Timeline lane label (freehand strokes), drawn in 10 px text at the left of a 16 px high lane. Very short.
timeline.lane.shape: Timeline lane label for arrows, rectangles, numbered badges and blur regions. Very short (about 6 characters).
timeline.lane.text: Timeline lane label for text annotations. Very short.
timeline.lane.voice: Timeline lane label for the speech/recording lane (transcribed speech lines). Very short.
tray.about: Tray item: opens the About window
tray.briefInEnglish: Tray checkbox: brief.md and the pasted instruction are always English
tray.captureRegion: Tray menu item, followed by a tab and the hotkey
tray.captureWindow: Tray menu item, followed by the hotkey
tray.language: Tray submenu title; ' / Language' is appended automatically in non-English UIs
tray.languageAuto: Language submenu: follow the Windows display language
tray.launchAtLoginDev: Tray checkbox, disabled in a development run
tray.pressEnter: Tray checkbox: press Enter in the agent window after pasting
tray.recaptureLast: Tray menu item: capture the same region again (for before/after comparison)
tray.sttDetect: Speech language submenu: Whisper detects the language
tray.sttLanguage: Tray submenu title: language for speech recognition
tray.support: Tray item: opens the donation page
